parts.name: Root
parts.description: The group container. It makes a div with role="group". It controls the selection across the Toggle.Root buttons in it, and it controls the roving focus.

props.name: value
props.description:
The selected values. When you give this prop, it is the source of truth, with `bind:value` or
without it. The component writes each change here and reports it through `onChange`.

Without a binding, that write stays local. Thus a parent that hears `onChange` and refuses the
change — it sends no new `value` down — sees the group move. The group then goes back to the
value of the parent at the next render.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected values at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the selection.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The number of the toggles that can be selected: one with `'single'`, or more than one with `'multiple'`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables each toggle in the group.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the layout. It sets the arrow keys that move the roving focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the group, usually `Toggle.Root` buttons.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the group element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the group element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the internal group context, for a complex composition.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole group is disabled.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One button of the group. It is Toggle.Root under the namespace of the group, and the two names are the same component.

props.name: value
props.description:
The stable identifier, which the component puts on the button. In a `ToggleGroup.Root`, the
selection needs it. It does not show the selected state.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description:
The selected state at the start, for when the component controls the state. In a
`ToggleGroup`, the component ignores it.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The selected state. You can bind it. When your own code controls the state, `undefined`
becomes `false`. In a `ToggleGroup`, the component ignores it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the selected state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the interaction with the toggle and removes it from the focus order.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content of the button. As a snippet, it can receive the current render state, for
example `selected`.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle or its group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present when the focus came from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the toggle.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle is held down.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-unselected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle is not selected.
